statement: Component-surjective and pairwise-injective degree-one comparisons imply H1(D,C) to H1(D,O) surjective; this excludes the specified affine-torsor pinch plus hyperbolic toric Kato cap assemblies, even when overlap Kato surfaces kill component loops.
notes: Explicit overlap hypotheses are essential. The horizontal pinch block is grouped because its individual genus-three conductor comparison is not injective. No unrestricted analytic cap comparison or classification is inferred.
